title: Maximum lumbar (L1-sacrum) flexion in forward bending

quantity.name: lumbar range of flexion
quantity.definition: L1 sensor relative to sacral sensor at max forward bending, from upright zero

source.sample: 20 healthy young males, no back/leg pain in previous 12 months

protocol.summary: Lumbar flexion at maximal forward bending (Fig 1).
how_to_use: Use 58.4 deg (SD ~16) as end-of-range lumbar flexion for young males; hips flex ~55 deg in the same task.

measurement.device: 3SPACE Fastrak (Polhemus): sensors on L1 spinous process, sacrum, lateral left and right thighs; 30 Hz per sensor
measurement.posture: standing, feet shoulder-width (zero = comfortable upright posture)
measurement.task: 3 continuous cycles of max forward-backward bending, left-right lateral bending, left-right twisting, 12 s per trial at comfortable speed; repeated 3 times

protocol.notes: Same value also inside kinematics.leewong2002.max_rom (do not double count).

pass_rule.rule: input data – not graded; use for robustness checks
